example.inputs: Example numbers: 20 missed calls a month; 1 in 4 is a new enquiry; you win 1 in 3 of the enquiries you answer; an average booking is $600.

features.name: Instant quotes
features.pain: Stop losing bookings while you work out the price.
features.searchLine: Instant quote software that prices every job the way you would, in seconds.

outcomes.saves: Saves the evenings you spend writing quotes.
outcomes.increases: Increases how many quotes turn into bookings.

features.intro: Customers answer a few questions and see a price straight away: per guest, per hour, per person or per room, by distance and date. You set the rules. Heyday does the maths and the chasing.

example.inputs: Example numbers: a business sends 40 quotes a month and usually replies the next day; an average booking is $1,200. Booking rates from Flashquotes’ data: 22% for quotes sent within 4 hours, 18% later the same day, 16% the next day or later.
example.maths: Next day: 40 × 16% = 6.4 bookings. Within 4 hours: 40 × 22% = 8.8 bookings. 8.8 − 6.4 = 2.4 extra bookings a month. 2.4 × $1,200 = $2,880.
example.result: $2,880 a month, or $34,560 a year, lost to slow quotes. Then a small calculator: the visitor enters their own quotes a month, win rate and average booking, and sees their number, with no email needed.

howItWorks.label: Instant quotes

howItWorks.line: The quote form on your site gives a priced quote with three options, on screen, as a PDF and by email.
